statements.impact_statement: anyhow 1.0.102 (unsoundness in Error::downcast_mut) enters the dependency tree solely through prost-derive, a procedural macro that runs at compile time and ships no code into the built broker; additionally, no code in this repository calls Error::downcast_mut (verified by tree-wide search, recorded in docs/delivery/0065-security-legibility.md).

The advisory's affected range for jsonwebtoken ends at 10.3.0 (introduced 0, fixed 10.3.0 per OSV); this product ships jsonwebtoken 11.0.0, which is outside the affected range — the vulnerable component version is not present. Scanners flagging it are mis-matching the range; recorded in docs/delivery/0069-scorecard-remediation.md.

rkyv 0.7 (out-of-bounds reads when validating untrusted archives containing Rc/Arc) enters the tree only as openraft -> byte-unit -> rust_decimal -> rkyv; no code in this product or that dependency chain deserializes rkyv archives, and no rkyv archive from any source — let alone an untrusted one — is ever constructed or read (tree-wide search: zero rkyv API call sites outside the vendored crates' own internals). The edge is not trimmable without forking upstream configuration; recorded in docs/delivery/0069-scorecard-remediation.md.
